policy_note: Scheduling priority is not a historical worth/orthodoxy ranking.

p0_backbone.rule: Work chronologically. Finish every currently locked-CORE missing ruler in the current backbone lane before advancing to the next lane. Short reigns remain included when they are CORE. REVIEW claimants do not block the lane.

p1_high_leverage_anchors.rule: Only starts after P0 backbone has no locked-CORE missing rulers. Rank remaining post-Qin CORE by evidence readiness, structural coverage gain, comparative value, transition leverage, and future simulation/visualization value. Do not confuse leverage with moral or historical worth.
